key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) reformulates Policy Mirror Descent for terminal-reward autoregressive generation into a trajectory-level objective, removing the need to estimate intermediate state values while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free reinforcement learning recipe for LLM reasoning that can simplify training, reduce value-function overhead, and improve practical stability for verifiable-reward tasks.
method: Derive a trajectory-level objective from the Bellman equations for terminal rewards.
Avoid state-value estimation at intermediate generation steps.
Use a practical BPO loss with a mismatch-correction weight based on a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where BPO demonstrates effective performance.
watch_item: The practical loss is an approximation of the reformulated objective, so performance may depend on how well the mismatch-correction weighting is tuned in implementation.
